tuition.assumptions: Conservative tuition-only ceiling for the ordinary full-time on-campus ECE MEng, completed within the department stated two-to-three continuous fall/spring semesters.

The official calculator identifies international graduate ECE MEng 1PKS1200MENG, entering Fall 2026, with USD 20,222 semester tuition at 12 billing hours. This is the full Range I tuition amount, distinct from the annual total and non-tuition costs.
At most three fall/spring semesters at that maximum ordinary semester rate gives USD 60,666. Reduced terminal loads can lower the total; no minimum or exact bill is asserted.

Fall 2027 rates are not yet offered by the calculator. The 2026-27 published-rate ceiling excludes future increases, summer or extended enrollment, extra study, fees, insurance and living costs. It is not the online degree price.

directory_policies.notes.9: Cost context: Published-rate tuition ceiling USD 60,666 for the ordinary full-time on-campus two-to-three-semester scope. A smaller budget remains pending until the billing schedule is known. Fees and future increases are excluded.

fact_summary: The department expects the on-campus MEng to finish in two to three continuous fall/spring semesters and links the exact official calculator. The maximum ordinary semester rate times three is a ceiling, not a mandatory three-semester bill.
